name: AgentActivity
label: Agent activity
description: What agents did on an account, each entry naming the agent and the person it acted for, with what waits on approval or was blocked.

props.name: attributionLabel
props.description: The line naming who acted, given the agent's and the person's names: "Ledger for Sara Ito".

props.name: outcomeLabels
props.description: The words for each outcome's mark. Defaults: none for `done`, then "Awaiting approval", "Declined" and "Blocked".

AgentActivityEntry.description: One thing an agent did, or tried to.

AgentActivityOutcome.description: How an agent's action ended: done, waiting on a person's approval, turned down by one, or stopped because the person it acts for does not hold that access.

AgentActivityOutcomeLabels.description: The words for each outcome's mark. `done` carries none unless given.

alternatives.name: Timeline
alternatives.when: the entries are steps or events with no agent behind them
